author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Nimmo diagnosed with sprained AC joint in shoulder
desc: Brandon Nimmo was diagnosed with a sprained AC joint in his left shoulder.
impact: Nimmo suffered the injury in Sunday's game against the Blue Jays. It is possible he'll require a stint on the injured list. There should be an update on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Glasnow (back) resumes throwing
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Monday that Tyler Glasnow has resumed a throwing progression.
impact: Roberts clarified that the team is still being cautious with Glasnow. It is a step in the right direction for his return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dane Myers leaves game early Monday
desc: Dane Myers was removed from Monday's game against the Brewers following a collision with the center-field wall.
impact: Myers was carted off the field following a collision on a catch he made. He will be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keider Montero to be moved to bullpen
desc: Tigers manager A.J. Hinch confirmed that Keider Montero is being moved to the bullpen.
impact: Montero had been pitching well as a starter. He'll add some length out of the bullpen for Detroit.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. exits early Monday
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. was removed from Monday's series opener against the Tigers early.
impact: Chisholm collided with teammate Jasson Domínguez. He was able to walk off under his own power to be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tanner Gordon (hip) to be activated Tuesday
desc: Tanner Gordon is expected to be activated for Tuesday's game against the Marlins.
impact: Gordon will get the start in place of Tomoyuki Sugano who is having his next start pushed back.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tomoyuki Sugano (finger) to have start pushed back
desc: Tomoyuki Sugano is dealing with a finger issue and will have his next start pushed back to later this week.
impact: Sugano was scheduled to start on Tuesday. He will instead likely make a start this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Pfaadt likely to be recalled Tuesday
desc: Brandon Pfaadt is likely to be recalled to start Tuesday's game against the Giants.
impact: Pfaadt will get an opportunity with the Diamondbacks rotation banged up. He is unlikely to be up for a long period of time.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Walker recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Orioles recalled LHP Josh Walker from Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Walker returns to a middle-relief role in the bullpen for Baltimore.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Keegan Akin (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Orioles placed LHP Keegan Akin on the 15-day injured list with left elbow discomfort.
impact: Akin does not hold a timetable to return. Josh Walker was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trent Grisham (hamstring) could begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone told reporters Trent Grisham could begin a minor league rehab assignment on Tuesday.
impact: It will be a brief rehab assignment as Grisham is expected to be activated later this week.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Cody Laweryson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Twins have recalled right-hander Cody Laweryson from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Laweryson has been recalled to take the roster spot of left-hander Anthony Banda (lat), who was placed on the 15-day injured list on Monday. The right-hander has posted a 5.06 ERA across 14 outings for the Twins this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Anthony Banda (lat) placed on IL, out months
desc: Twins left-hander Anthony Banda (lat) has been placed on the 15-day injured list, and will reportedly be out for months rather than weeks.
impact: Banda departed Sunday's game with left side discomfort, and the injury is reportedly much worse than originally thought. The southpaw is expected to miss months with his lat injury, and it's within reason that his season could be in jeopardy. Right-hander Cody Laweryson has been recalled to take his place on the active roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Smith (foot) in lineup Monday
desc: Cam Smith is in the Astros lineup on Monday against the Tigers.
impact: Smith returns from a one-game absence. He is starting in right field and batting sixth.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Kennedy activated by Mariners
impact: Kennedy will hold a depth role off the bench with Rob Refsnyder placed on the injured list.
